transcript: Speaker A: लोग सोचते हैं इंग्लिश ना आना छोटी बात है... [People think not knowing English is a minor issue, but it causes embarrassment. My sister suggested the 'English Seekho' app. I practiced daily for 15 minutes, learning conversational English and practicing with AI coach Disha. on_screen_text: Captions in Hindi narrate the story of the salon worker's struggle with English, her sister's recommendation of the 'English Seekho' app, and her subsequent business success. It concludes with a call to action: 'English Seekho app download karo aur ek rupaye ke trial se shuru karo' [Download the English Seekho app and start with a 1-rupee trial] and a standard legal disclaimer.
summary: A skilled salon worker shares how her lack of English cost her a premium client, prompting her to use the 'English Seekho' app. Daily practice with the app's lessons and AI coach helped her gain confidence, attract high-paying customers, and boost her earnings.
